text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Kawasaki Kinen drew near—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, we've looked back at footage 
focusing on the dirt races from the end of 
last year! Falco-san, what are your 
thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, every single race was so 
amazing! Everyone was shining so brightly! 
Falco's heart was beating super fast☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san really is amazing... Even after 
stepping back from the front lines, she's 
always shining so brightly... So cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...On a certain TV show looking back at 
dirt races, Smart Falcon had been invited 
on as a special guest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it had been a while since she was on 
TV, we were watching together like this, 
but—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"The dirt scene is booming right now, 
but... To get straight to the point! Is 
there any chance we will see Falco-san 
make a comeback!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —I waaaant to make my comeback so badly!

text_block_list.name: Venue Uproar
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No way...! Falco-san made a comeback...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"She said it might be tough to do within 
the year, though. There are still a few 
things I want to do as an Umadol before 
the year ends ☆"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I see...! But wow, just announcing your 
comeback is already causing shockwaves! 
Even I'm getting excited!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu. But—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If someone truly dazzling appears this 
year, I might push myself for a comeback 
toward the end of the yearâaiming for 
something like the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! When you say "a dazzling girl," 
what kind of Umamusume are you referring 
to, specifically?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe a girl who sets a historic 
record, or something☆

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Historic, you say? Well, that's quite a 
high bar! I'd be thrilled if someone like 
that appeared, but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —I'm being serious, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I truly want you to drag my heart back to 
racing once more with a sparkle that will 
go down in history!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone on the dirt tracks! This is a 
challenge from me!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Shine with me! And let's create the most 
brilliantly sparkling race in the world!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A challenge—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's series of remarks became a 
trending topic in no time—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Does this mean she's basically confirmed 
to make a comeback?!" "Falco-chan is so 
cool...!" "I wanna see Falco race again!!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Take all the time you need, we'll be 
waiting for you!" "I really hope she gets 
to run with Wonder Acute!" "Show us that 
Tokyo Daishoten magic once more!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The day after that broadcast. During 
training time—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. What do you think a 'historic 
record' really is?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...To me, Falco-san is like a living 
legend.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Both as a dirt Umamusume... and as an 
'Umadol'... shining brighter and looking 
cooler than anyone else—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Along with admiring them... I thought time 
and time again that if I could shine like 
that, I'd be able to invite so many more 
people to Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Still, precisely because I thought about 
it and yearned for it so many times, this 
is how I feel now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The possibility of competing against 
Falco-san... I feel like that could be a 
huge opportunity for my dream, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Competing against Falco-san, who's 
practically a legend, will draw 
unprecedented attention and gain us more 
fans...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I know it's reckless. Even 
so, for Tomakomai's sake, I really want to 
take on this challenge...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce determination to take on the 
challenge radiated from Hokko Tarumae. As 
her Trainer, I have no choice but to 
respect it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I reflect on what Hokko Tarumae 
asked— what a 'historic record' really 
means to me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...A few things came to mind. For 
instance, winning a prestigious overseas 
dirt race, or—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things like winning a variety of graded 
stakes races regardless of distance or 
aptitude, or racking up win after win 
through a reckless, packed racing 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among those, the easiest to understand is 
likely— "The most GⅠ victories in 
history," wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Total GⅠ wins— Showing it in numbers is 
definitely the clearest way for anyone to 
understand...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Could you review our race 
rotation so that the probability of me 
setting a historic record is as high as 
possible?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for that distant, towering peak 
where the Falcon waits, we decided to 
reevaluate our future race plans once 
more—
